description: 2 tactical challenges for White in the Milner-Barry Gambit. Sacrifice with 7.O-O! and attack down the open lines.

drills.briefExplanation: 7.O-O! dxc3 8.Nxc3 Bb4 9.Bg5 — sacrifice, develop, and pin.
drills.description: White to play. Black took on d4 — offer the Milner-Barry with 7.O-O!.
drills.explanation: The Milner-Barry Gambit: instead of recapturing on d4, White castles with 7.O-O!, sacrificing the pawn for the initiative. After 7...dxc3 8.Nxc3 White has open lines, fast development, and direct attacking chances against Black's king — the French's solid structure becomes a target. One inaccurate defense and the attack breaks through.
drills.name: The O-O Sacrifice

drills.briefExplanation: 8.Nxc3 Nge7 9.Nb5! a6 10.Nd6+! — develop, leap, and fork with check.
drills.description: White to play. Black took the pawn — recapture and jump to b5.
drills.explanation: The follow-up: after 7...dxc3 8.Nxc3 Nge7, White plays the energetic 9.Nb5! — and after 9...a6 comes 10.Nd6+!, forking with check. Black's extra pawn is meaningless while the king is stuck; White's initiative converts to material.
drills.name: The Nb5 Leap

name: Milner-Barry Gambit — White Tactics
